facts.statement: All current players were to receive a 'party pack' bundle of in-game items to celebrate the two million milestone, rolled out in stages over two weeks.
facts.quote: all current players will receive a “party pack” bundle of in-game items to help celebrate! The packs will be rolled out in stages over the next two weeks.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post announces that Free Realms registered its two millionth player, reached in under a month. It gives the player age and gender split and describes how current players claim a 'party pack' bundle of in-game items through the Marketplace, Claim and Membership button. The exact post date is not shown; the capture is 2009-05-30 and the post says it was made 2 days and 10 hours before that page view.
